description: Single-path TRPO likelihood-ratio surrogate minimized over selected-action log probabilities and detached old-policy advantages. Uses q=pi_old and the advantage form equivalent up to a constant to the paper's Q form; callers own the KL constraint and policy update (Schulman et al., §5 Eqs. (13)–(14), §5.1; structured bindings: src/topologies/training/recipes/structured_objective.py:36-50).

examples.code:
import tempfile
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
from topologies import Trainer, build, synth
root = tempfile.mkdtemp()
@synth.generator
def rollouts(ctx):
    state = torch.randn(4, generator=ctx.rng.torch)
    action = int(ctx.index) % 2
    advantage = float(int(ctx.index) % 5 - 2)
    inputs = torch.cat((state, torch.tensor([float(action)])))
    return {"inputs": synth.Tensor(inputs), "advantage": synth.Tensor(torch.tensor(advantage)), "old_log_prob": synth.Tensor(torch.tensor(-0.6931471805599453))}
dataset = synth.Spec("trpo-rollouts", generator=rollouts, size=12, splits={"train": 1.0}, seed=7, root=root, monitor="none").run()
train = dataset.for_recipe("structured-objective", split="train")
class Policy(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.network = build("mlp", "tiny", in_features=4, out_features=2)
    def forward(self, inputs):
        logits = self.network(inputs[..., :4])
        log_probabilities = torch.log_softmax(logits, dim=-1)
        actions = inputs[..., 4].long().unsqueeze(-1)
        return {"log_probability": log_probabilities.gather(-1, actions).squeeze(-1)}
trainer = Trainer(Policy(), train, recipe="structured-objective", recipe_config={"loss": "trpo", "loss_kwargs": {"reduction": "mean"}, "bindings": {"logits_or_prediction": {"output": "log_probability"}, "targets": {"batch": "advantage"}, "old_log_prob": {"batch": "old_log_prob"}}}, batch_size=4, max_epochs=1, device="cpu")
trainer.fit()
examples.title: Train a policy with the TRPO surrogate

name: TRPO policy surrogate loss

parameters.ignore_index: must be None; transition masking is unsupported
parameters.logits_or_prediction: floating-point selected-action log probabilities under the current policy, shape [B]
parameters.old_log_prob: required floating-point selected-action log probabilities under the sampling policy pi_old, shape [B], detached from gradients
parameters.reduction: none returns per-sample losses, mean averages samples, or sum totals samples (default mean)
parameters.targets: floating-point advantages estimated under the old policy, shape [B], detached from gradients
